units.rawText: <size=28>I... This is... </size>
units.displayText: I... This is...

spans.text: I... This is...

units.rawText: <size=28>Big Sis... Alcyone...?</size>
units.displayText: Big Sis... Alcyone...?

spans.text: Big Sis... Alcyone...?

units.rawText: Electra? Are you awake? What did you say just now?
units.displayText: Electra? Are you awake? What did you say just now?

spans.text: Electra? Are you awake? What did you say just now?

units.rawText: My vision and hearing gradually return.
units.displayText: My vision and hearing gradually return.

spans.text: My vision and hearing gradually return.

units.rawText: The form of the girl before me resolves into clarity. There is a look of concern on her exquisite face, directed at me.
units.displayText: The form of the girl before me resolves into clarity. There is a look of concern on her exquisite face, directed at me.

spans.text: The form of the girl before me resolves into clarity. There is a look of concern on her exquisite face, directed at me.

units.rawText: Ah, yes... I passed out during the battle just now...
units.displayText: Ah, yes... I passed out during the battle just now...

spans.text: Ah, yes... I passed out during the battle just now...

units.rawText: Were you taking care of me all this time, Ally?
units.displayText: Were you taking care of me all this time, Ally?

spans.text: Were you taking care of me all this time, Ally?

units.rawText: Ugh... Good morning, Ally?
units.displayText: Ugh... Good morning, Ally?

spans.text: Ugh... Good morning, Ally?

units.rawText: I'm so sorry!
units.displayText: I'm so sorry!

spans.text: I'm so sorry!

units.rawText: I was not expecting that. Surely this scratch doesn't warrant an apology from her, right?
units.displayText: I was not expecting that. Surely this scratch doesn't warrant an apology from her, right?

spans.text: I was not expecting that. Surely this scratch doesn't warrant an apology from her, right?

units.rawText: Haha, what's there to be sorry about when your Big Sis gets a chance to slack off on the battlefield...
units.displayText: Haha, what's there to be sorry about when your Big Sis gets a chance to slack off on the battlefield...

spans.text: Haha, what's there to be sorry about when your Big Sis gets a chance to slack off on the battlefield...

units.rawText: Atlas...
units.displayText: Atlas...

spans.text: Atlas...

units.rawText: Atlas? An ominous feeling rises within my heart.
units.displayText: Atlas? An ominous feeling rises within my heart.

spans.text: Atlas? An ominous feeling rises within my heart.

units.rawText: Shortly afterwards.
units.displayText: Shortly afterwards.

spans.text: Shortly afterwards.

units.rawText: I see... Atlas was a hero to the very end.
units.displayText: I see... Atlas was a hero to the very end.

spans.text: I see... Atlas was a hero to the very end.

units.rawText: I'm so sorry!
units.displayText: I'm so sorry!

spans.text: I'm so sorry!

units.rawText: Ally bows vigorously.
units.displayText: Ally bows vigorously.

spans.text: Ally bows vigorously.

units.rawText: I know apologizing won't solve anything, and I know I don't deserve forgiveness from you or Atlas.
units.displayText: I know apologizing won't solve anything, and I know I don't deserve forgiveness from you or Atlas.

spans.text: I know apologizing won't solve anything, and I know I don't deserve forgiveness from you or Atlas.

units.rawText: But I hope you'll give me a chance to redeem myself. This time, I promise I'll protect you.
units.displayText: But I hope you'll give me a chance to redeem myself. This time, I promise I'll protect you.

spans.text: But I hope you'll give me a chance to redeem myself. This time, I promise I'll protect you.

units.rawText: I'll make sure I honor Atlas' dying wish.
units.displayText: I'll make sure I honor Atlas' dying wish.

spans.text: I'll make sure I honor Atlas' dying wish.

units.rawText: And I won't disgrace my status as a Sanctifier.
units.displayText: And I won't disgrace my status as a Sanctifier.

spans.text: And I won't disgrace my status as a Sanctifier.

units.rawText: She clenches her fists and grits her teeth. Her entire body is so tense that it's trembling.
units.displayText: She clenches her fists and grits her teeth. Her entire body is so tense that it's trembling.

spans.text: She clenches her fists and grits her teeth. Her entire body is so tense that it's trembling.

units.rawText: However, the look in her eyes is more resolute than anything.
units.displayText: However, the look in her eyes is more resolute than anything.

spans.text: However, the look in her eyes is more resolute than anything.

units.rawText: I understand.
units.displayText: I understand.

spans.text: I understand.

units.rawText: You're the one who needs the most comfort now, yet you're taking care of my feelings instead.
units.displayText: You're the one who needs the most comfort now, yet you're taking care of my feelings instead.

spans.text: You're the one who needs the most comfort now, yet you're taking care of my feelings instead.

units.rawText: Honestly, all you need to do is cry and weep and I... And Atlas too, we would have forgiven you right away.
units.displayText: Honestly, all you need to do is cry and weep and I... And Atlas too, we would have forgiven you right away.

spans.text: Honestly, all you need to do is cry and weep and I... And Atlas too, we would have forgiven you right away.

units.rawText: In that case, what I can do is...
units.displayText: In that case, what I can do is...

spans.text: In that case, what I can do is...

units.rawText: Ally, start the repair program. I need to get back into fighting condition.
units.displayText: Ally, start the repair program. I need to get back into fighting condition.

spans.text: Ally, start the repair program. I need to get back into fighting condition.

units.rawText: ...Yeah! Let me run a diagnostic.
units.displayText: ...Yeah! Let me run a diagnostic.

spans.text: ...Yeah! Let me run a diagnostic.

units.rawText: Eh... There's no need for that, right...
units.displayText: Eh... There's no need for that, right...

spans.text: Eh... There's no need for that, right...

units.rawText: Ally ignores me, activates the diagnostic program on the recovery device, and begins an in-depth scan on me.
units.displayText: Ally ignores me, activates the diagnostic program on the recovery device, and begins an in-depth scan on me.

spans.text: Ally ignores me, activates the diagnostic program on the recovery device, and begins an in-depth scan on me.

units.rawText: —Commencing full diagnostic.
units.displayText: —Commencing full diagnostic.

spans.text: —Commencing full diagnostic.

units.rawText: —Operator ID confirmed: Sanctifier.
units.displayText: —Operator ID confirmed: Sanctifier.

spans.text: —Operator ID confirmed: Sanctifier.

units.rawText: —Warning! Threat detected!
units.displayText: —Warning! Threat detected!

spans.text: —Warning! Threat detected!

units.rawText: Ugh..!
units.displayText: Ugh..!

spans.text: Ugh..!

units.rawText: A threat? What is this... Is something wrong with the system?
units.displayText: A threat? What is this... Is something wrong with the system?

spans.text: A threat? What is this... Is something wrong with the system?

units.rawText: Why did it flag Ally as a threat...
units.displayText: Why did it flag Ally as a threat...

spans.text: Why did it flag Ally as a threat...

units.rawText: Electra? Are you okay?
units.displayText: Electra? Are you okay?

spans.text: Electra? Are you okay?

units.rawText: The system threw up an error. It's okay.
units.displayText: The system threw up an error. It's okay.

spans.text: The system threw up an error. It's okay.

units.rawText: You, on the other hand, did you get hurt while fighting?
units.displayText: You, on the other hand, did you get hurt while fighting?

spans.text: You, on the other hand, did you get hurt while fighting?

units.rawText: You should be worrying more about yourself right now! Anyway it was just a scratch, it's already healed.
units.displayText: You should be worrying more about yourself right now! Anyway it was just a scratch, it's already healed.

spans.text: You should be worrying more about yourself right now! Anyway it was just a scratch, it's already healed.

units.rawText: Haha, you looked so out of it that I thought there was something wrong with your neural cloud.
units.displayText: Haha, you looked so out of it that I thought there was something wrong with your neural cloud.

spans.text: Haha, you looked so out of it that I thought there was something wrong with your neural cloud.

units.rawText: Why you—!
units.displayText: Why you—!

spans.text: Why you—!

units.rawText: Thank goodness, looks like Ally wasn't infected. There's no need to worry about her, then.
units.displayText: Thank goodness, looks like Ally wasn't infected. There's no need to worry about her, then.

spans.text: Thank goodness, looks like Ally wasn't infected. There's no need to worry about her, then.

units.rawText: Ally, begin the repair process. Lord Eosphorus and the others need me.
units.displayText: Ally, begin the repair process. Lord Eosphorus and the others need me.

spans.text: Ally, begin the repair process. Lord Eosphorus and the others need me.

units.rawText: Also, this isn't the time to make her worry.
units.displayText: Also, this isn't the time to make her worry.

spans.text: Also, this isn't the time to make her worry.

units.rawText: But—
units.displayText: But—

spans.text: But—

units.rawText: (Coughs) Well, there are three reasons why I need to heal up ASAP.
units.displayText: (Coughs) Well, there are three reasons why I need to heal up ASAP.

spans.text: (Coughs) Well, there are three reasons why I need to heal up ASAP.

units.rawText: First, Lord Eosphorus entrusted us with defending this tower and synchronizing the activation of the Halos.
units.displayText: First, Lord Eosphorus entrusted us with defending this tower and synchronizing the activation of the Halos.

spans.text: First, Lord Eosphorus entrusted us with defending this tower and synchronizing the activation of the Halos.

units.rawText: Second, we are in the heart of enemy territory, and we need a frontliner if we're to complete the mission.
units.displayText: Second, we are in the heart of enemy territory, and we need a frontliner if we're to complete the mission.

spans.text: Second, we are in the heart of enemy territory, and we need a frontliner if we're to complete the mission.

units.rawText: Third, and most important of all...
units.displayText: Third, and most important of all...

spans.text: Third, and most important of all...

units.rawText: You're just so cuuuuuuuuuute, so I want to be with you and squish your face~
units.displayText: You're just so cuuuuuuuuuute, so I want to be with you and squish your face~

spans.text: You're just so cuuuuuuuuuute, so I want to be with you and squish your face~

units.rawText: ...Humph, don't try to make me laugh. This isn't the time for it!
units.displayText: ...Humph, don't try to make me laugh. This isn't the time for it!

spans.text: ...Humph, don't try to make me laugh. This isn't the time for it!

units.rawText: Ahhhhhhh seeing Ally try her best to hold back tears is so so so so cute, too...
units.displayText: Ahhhhhhh seeing Ally try her best to hold back tears is so so so so cute, too...

spans.text: Ahhhhhhh seeing Ally try her best to hold back tears is so so so so cute, too...

units.rawText: Or would you rather I squish your face right now~
units.displayText: Or would you rather I squish your face right now~

spans.text: Or would you rather I squish your face right now~

units.rawText: Nonono, I'll get you healed.
units.displayText: Nonono, I'll get you healed.

spans.text: Nonono, I'll get you healed.

units.rawText: Just relax and recover...
units.displayText: Just relax and recover...

spans.text: Just relax and recover...

units.rawText: Alcyone enters the codes to begin the healing on the console.
units.displayText: Alcyone enters the codes to begin the healing on the console.

spans.text: Alcyone enters the codes to begin the healing on the console.

units.rawText: Yeah... Then I guess I'll... rest for a bit...
units.displayText: Yeah... Then I guess I'll... rest for a bit...

spans.text: Yeah... Then I guess I'll... rest for a bit...

units.rawText: As the healing machinery activates, a wave of fatigue washes over me.
units.displayText: As the healing machinery activates, a wave of fatigue washes over me.

spans.text: As the healing machinery activates, a wave of fatigue washes over me.

units.rawText: Ally...
units.displayText: Ally...

spans.text: Ally...

units.rawText: What?
units.displayText: What?

spans.text: What?

units.rawText: Atlas might be gone, but I'm sure we'll meet again. I have a hunch...
units.displayText: Atlas might be gone, but I'm sure we'll meet again. I have a hunch...

spans.text: Atlas might be gone, but I'm sure we'll meet again. I have a hunch...

units.rawText: But the Atlas who's reborn from the Pantheon won't be the Atlas from before...
units.displayText: But the Atlas who's reborn from the Pantheon won't be the Atlas from before...

spans.text: But the Atlas who's reborn from the Pantheon won't be the Atlas from before...

units.rawText: Don't say any more. Leave the rest to me.
units.displayText: Don't say any more. Leave the rest to me.

spans.text: Don't say any more. Leave the rest to me.

units.rawText: You're so reliable, Alcyone...
units.displayText: You're so reliable, Alcyone...

spans.text: You're so reliable, Alcyone...

units.rawText: As she watches Electra close her eyes again, Alcyone steps forward and gently strokes her face.
units.displayText: As she watches Electra close her eyes again, Alcyone steps forward and gently strokes her face.

spans.text: As she watches Electra close her eyes again, Alcyone steps forward and gently strokes her face.

units.rawText: Reliable, huh... If only I were reliable enough to support you all.
units.displayText: Reliable, huh... If only I were reliable enough to support you all.

spans.text: Reliable, huh... If only I were reliable enough to support you all.

units.rawText: I will NOT make the same mistakes again. This time, I'll protect all of you.
units.displayText: I will NOT make the same mistakes again. This time, I'll protect all of you.

spans.text: I will NOT make the same mistakes again. This time, I'll protect all of you.

units.rawText: Alcyone turns to the console and examines the rows and columns on it.
units.displayText: Alcyone turns to the console and examines the rows and columns on it.

spans.text: Alcyone turns to the console and examines the rows and columns on it.

units.rawText: Insufficient operands... If I infuse some of my operands, that should allow me to activate some of the defense systems, just in case.
units.displayText: Insufficient operands... If I infuse some of my operands, that should allow me to activate some of the defense systems, just in case.

spans.text: Insufficient operands... If I infuse some of my operands, that should allow me to activate some of the defense systems, just in case.

units.rawText: Operand infusion detected. Defense systems activated.
units.displayText: Operand infusion detected. Defense systems activated.

spans.text: Operand infusion detected. Defense systems activated.

units.rawText: Reallocating operands. All power has been transferred to Halo generation, repair systems and fire control systems.
units.displayText: Reallocating operands. All power has been transferred to Halo generation, repair systems and fire control systems.

spans.text: Reallocating operands. All power has been transferred to Halo generation, repair systems and fire control systems.

units.rawText: This ought to do it...
units.displayText: This ought to do it...

spans.text: This ought to do it...

units.rawText: Alcyone folds her arms and looks back at the sleeping Electra.
units.displayText: Alcyone folds her arms and looks back at the sleeping Electra.

spans.text: Alcyone folds her arms and looks back at the sleeping Electra.

units.rawText: Have a good rest, Electra. When you wake up again, we'll be able to...
units.displayText: Have a good rest, Electra. When you wake up again, we'll be able to...

spans.text: Have a good rest, Electra. When you wake up again, we'll be able to...

units.rawText: She's actually smiling... honestly, what on earth is she seeing in her dreams...
units.displayText: She's actually smiling... honestly, what on earth is she seeing in her dreams...

spans.text: She's actually smiling... honestly, what on earth is she seeing in her dreams...

units.rawText: Before I knew it, you went ahead of me again.
units.displayText: Before I knew it, you went ahead of me again.

spans.text: Before I knew it, you went ahead of me again.

units.rawText: Big Sis Alcyone.
units.displayText: Big Sis Alcyone.

spans.text: Big Sis Alcyone.

units.rawText: <color=orange>I lost you in the previous big battle.</color>
units.displayText: I lost you in the previous big battle.

spans.text: I lost you in the previous big battle.

units.rawText: <color=orange>When you awoke in the Pantheon, you didn't remember me, your little sister.</color>
units.displayText: When you awoke in the Pantheon, you didn't remember me, your little sister.

spans.text: When you awoke in the Pantheon, you didn't remember me, your little sister.

units.rawText: <color=orange>Still, that's only to be expected. When Sanctifiers are "reborn", their memories don't come with them.</color>
units.displayText: Still, that's only to be expected. When Sanctifiers are "reborn", their memories don't come with them.

spans.text: Still, that's only to be expected. When Sanctifiers are "reborn", their memories don't come with them.

units.rawText: <color=orange>Fortunately, we're sisters again.</color>
units.displayText: Fortunately, we're sisters again.

spans.text: Fortunately, we're sisters again.

units.rawText: <color=orange>The difference is... This time it's my turn to be the elder sibling.</color>
units.displayText: The difference is... This time it's my turn to be the elder sibling.

spans.text: The difference is... This time it's my turn to be the elder sibling.

units.rawText: <color=orange>Even so, I can't help but get all clingy around you.</color>
units.displayText: Even so, I can't help but get all clingy around you.

spans.text: Even so, I can't help but get all clingy around you.

units.rawText: <color=orange>I'll protect you this time...</color>
units.displayText: I'll protect you this time...

spans.text: I'll protect you this time...
